title: Clícalo shared catalog definitions
description: Definitions shared by every catalog and content schema. Referenced through relative $ref.

schemaRef.description: Editor hint pointing at the schema of the file. Ignored by the product.

catalogVersion.description: Monotonic version of a catalog; stored in CatalogRef when content is copied into a document (DAT-004).

langCode.description: Language code (IDI-006 allows more languages than es and en).

localizedText.description: Text per language. Spanish and English are mandatory (IDI-001); other languages may be added.

localizedWords.description: Lower-case search words per language, accents included (CAT-002).

messageKey.description: Key of a product text in data/i18n/strings.<lang>.json.

keyId.description: Canonical, persisted key identity: a lower-case name (ctrl, a, num.add) or a layout-dependent character (char:ñ) resolved when sending (PQ-49).

keyChord.description: Keys in press order (EJE-003); released in reverse order.

iconId.description: Material Symbols Rounded icon name listed in data/catalogs/icons.json.

itemId.description: Stable identifier of a catalog item, unique within its file; part of CatalogRef.

processName.description: Executable file name without path, in lower case (PER-002 compares without case).

duration.description: Non-negative duration with an explicit unit: ms, s, min, h or d (for example 600ms, 2.5s, 10min).
